summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release (September 20, 2022) reporting residential construction statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 3b lists "Not seasonally adjusted" housing starts for the United States and four regions (Northeast, Midwest, South, West), including July (revised) and August (preliminary) 2022 data. This document supplies the raw monthly values required to calculate the August 2022 momentum score for each region. It confirms the national total increased from 126.1k to 140.5k, satisfying the task's filter condition for this specific month. As the first report covering August 2022, it provides the baseline data for the start of the 2022/08–2025/05 window, though subsequent monthly releases may revise these figures under the task's precedence rule.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release on New Residential Construction for September 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 3b provides monthly Not Seasonally Adjusted housing starts data for the United States and four regions (Northeast, Midwest, South, West) from July 2022 through September 2022. This supplies the raw values required to calculate month-over-month momentum scores for August and September 2022. It includes U.S. national totals necessary to apply the filter for months where national starts increased: U.S. starts rose from July (123.7) to August (140.1), including August's momentum, but fell from August (140.1) to September (124.4), excluding September's momentum. Data ends in September 2022, leaving the period from October 2022 through May 2025 to be covered by subsequent reports.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release for October 2022 (issued November 17, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 3b provides "Not seasonally adjusted" housing starts data for the United States and four regions (Northeast, Midwest, South, West) from July 2022 through October 2022. This covers the initial segment of the required 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe, supplying the national and regional totals needed to calculate month-over-month momentum scores for August, September, and October 2022. It enables application of the national increase filter: August 2022 shows an increase from July (eligible), while September and October show declines (ineligible). Data is preliminary for October and revised for prior months in this release; while authoritative at this point, later monthly reports may supersede these values per the task's precedence rule. The document is limited as it lacks data for the remainder of the period (2023–2025).
